To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
vibrotactile devices can be used in communicating emotional intention from one person to the other.
vibrotactile communication of intended emotional states can be improved by using different touch gestures.

the touch gesture of squeezing the device was best at conveying unpleasant and arousing emotions, whereas the touch gesture of touching the device with fingers was best at conveying pleasant and relaxing emotions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to use touch gestures to create vibrotactile feedback for communicating emotional intentions between people.
how people communicate via touch gestures and how this can be mediated using tactile technology.
the development of a novel communication technology that enables people, in the future, to communicate with each other by using touch gestures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the touch gestures squeeze and finger touch can convey intended emotional intention from one person to the other via vibrotactiles stimulation.
the results showed that the touch gestures of squeezing and touching with fingers were better at communicating unpleasant or aroused emotional intention than pleasant or relaxed emotional intention.
the results showed that the vibrotactile stimuli that imitated human touch could convey intended emotions from a sender to a receiver.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
vibrotactile communication is a promising way to communicate emotions between people, but it is still far from perfect.
the use of touch gestures in vibrotactile mediated communication can be used for conveying emotional intentions.
the touch gestures of squeeze, finger touch and finger touch with two fingers were successfully used to communicate emotional intention via vibro-tactile stimulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of touch gesture is crucial in communicating emotional intention.
vibrotactile touch can be a promising medium for interpersonal emotional communication.
vibrotactile touch gestures can be used to convey emotional intention between people.
